articles.title: “Doctor Attacked Inside Hospital”: BRIMS Resident Suffers Fracture After Mob Assault in Bidar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 28-year-old doctor was brutally assaulted inside the casualty ward of Bidar District Government Hospital (BRIMS) in Karnataka, allegedly by relatives of a patient, triggering outrage among medical professionals. The incident took place around 12:30 am when Dr.

body.html:
A 28-year-old doctor was brutally assaulted inside the casualty ward of Bidar District Government Hospital (BRIMS) in Karnataka, allegedly by relatives of a patient, triggering outrage among medical professionals.

The incident took place around 12:30 am when Dr. Tukaram, an Orthopaedics postgraduate resident, was on duty in the emergency ward.

According to the police complaint, the doctor was attending to a patient identified as Vijayasingh, who had reportedly sustained injuries after falling from a motorcycle.

A group claiming to be the patient’s relatives allegedly entered the ward and accused the doctor of not providing proper treatment. The confrontation soon escalated into violence, with the accused allegedly abusing the doctor, issuing death threats, and preventing him from treating other patients.

The attackers allegedly grabbed Dr. Tukaram, pushed him to the ground, and repeatedly punched and kicked him inside the casualty ward.

In his complaint, the doctor described the assault as an “attempt to murder.”

Hospital staff rushed to the spot and rescued the injured doctor, who sustained serious injuries, including a maxillary fracture. He is currently undergoing treatment at the same hospital.

According to preliminary information, the violence may also have been linked to a dispute over registration of a medico-legal case (MLC). Sources said the youths allegedly insisted that hospital authorities should not register an MLC after the motorcycle accident.

Confusion reportedly arose after laboratory staff informed the group that an MLC had already been registered, leading to an argument inside the hospital premises. Despite Dr. Tukaram allegedly clarifying that no MLC had been filed at that point, the group allegedly turned violent.

The Karnataka Association of Resident Doctors (KARD) strongly condemned the attack and raised concerns over the safety of healthcare workers in emergency wards and trauma care settings.

The FIR names seven accused — Aditya, Vinod, Govind, Anil, Mahadev, Balaji and Pawan — along with several unidentified individuals.

Police have arrested five persons directly involved in the assault so far. Authorities are also expected to examine CCTV footage and record statements from hospital staff as part of the investigation.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Man Dragged Into Saryu River While Preparing Mother-in-Law’s Last Rites in Gonda
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic incident was reported from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district where a 30-year-old man was dragged into the Saryu river by a crocodile while preparing for his mother-in-law’s funeral rites.

body.html:
A tragic incident was reported from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district where a 30-year-old man was dragged into the Saryu river by a crocodile while preparing for his mother-in-law’s funeral rites.

The incident took place on Wednesday afternoon in the Umri Begumganj police station area, around 35 km from the district headquarters.

The victim, identified as Deepak Sharma, a resident of Pari Chowk, Greater Noida, had come to Gonda with his wife Rekha and four-year-old daughter to attend the last rites of his mother-in-law Urmila Devi, who had died of cancer on Tuesday.

According to family members and eyewitnesses, the funeral ceremony was being prepared near the Saryu river at Sanauli Mohammadpur Udaybhan Pahi. Around noon, Deepak was digging and fixing stakes for the funeral pyre near the riverbank.

Locals had reportedly warned him about crocodiles frequently being spotted in the area and advised him not to go close to the water. However, after finishing the work, Deepak went to the riverbank to wash his hands.

Eyewitnesses said that as soon as he bent near the water, a crocodile suddenly emerged from the river, clamped his head in its jaws, and dragged him underwater within seconds. People present at the ghat screamed for help, but nobody could enter the river out of fear.

One eyewitness claimed he tried to catch hold of Deepak while the crocodile dragged him away but fell into the water during the attempt.

Following the incident, police and local boatmen launched a search operation. Officials from the Revenue Department and local divers also joined the rescue efforts. SDM Tarbganj reached the spot to monitor the situation, while an SDRF team was called from Lucknow.

After an intensive search operation that began at 8 am on Thursday, the SDRF team recovered Deepak’s body near the Umri Begumganj area after nearly four hours of continuous diving.

Police later took custody of the body and sent it for post-mortem examination in the presence of family members.

The Gonda District Disaster Management Department announced financial assistance of ₹4 lakh for Deepak’s wife Rekha Verma following the tragedy.

articles.title: “Reelbaaz” Arrested After Harassing Schoolgirls in Shamli
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man accused of harassing schoolgirls while making social media reels was arrested by Uttar Pradesh Police in Shamli after videos of his actions went viral online.

body.html:
A man accused of harassing schoolgirls while making social media reels was arrested by Uttar Pradesh Police in Shamli after videos of his actions went viral online.

The accused, identified as Shah Nawaz Ansari, allegedly used to stop school-going girls near public places and schools in the Thanabhavan area to make reels and perform obscene gestures.

According to police, the incident triggered widespread outrage on social media after videos related to the accused surfaced online. Following the backlash, the Thanabhavan Police Station’s Mission Shakti and Anti-Romeo Team launched action against him.

Police confirmed that one accused was arrested in connection with making obscene gestures and creating reels near schools and public places under the Thanabhavan Police Station limits.

Officials said strict action was taken keeping women’s safety in mind. The accused was later sent to jail.

The incident has once again raised concerns over harassment of female students in public spaces and misuse of social media content creation for nuisance and intimidation.

articles.title: Father Arrested for Murdering Teen Daughter, Dismembering Body and Dumping It on Train in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling case from Uttar Pradesh has shocked the nation after a 15-year-old girl’s dismembered body was found inside a tin box on a train in Lucknow. On May 17, the torso of the victim, identified as Shabba, was discovered stuffed inside a tin box at a railway station in Lucknow.

body.html:
A chilling case from Uttar Pradesh has shocked the nation after a 15-year-old girl’s dismembered body was found inside a tin box on a train in Lucknow.

On May 17, the torso of the victim, identified as Shabba, was discovered stuffed inside a tin box at a railway station in Lucknow. Her severed hands and legs were recovered from a nearby bag, while her head was missing.

A week after the gruesome discovery, Uttar Pradesh Police arrested the girl’s father, Biggan Ansari, who allegedly confessed to the murder.

According to police, Ansari killed his daughter over her alleged relationship with a boy from another community. Investigators said he feared “social stigma” and believed his third daughter was “following the same path” after two of his daughters had earlier left home.

Police said the teenager had been speaking to the boy over the phone despite repeated warnings from her father to end contact with him.

As part of the alleged conspiracy, Ansari first sent his wife and two sons to a relative’s house on May 16. He then informed his sister Noorjahan and brother-in-law Mujibulla — both accused in the case — about the murder plan, police said.

Investigators revealed that Ansari allegedly killed the teenager, dismembered the body, and dumped the severed head in a village pond to prevent identification. The torso was packed inside a tin box, while the limbs were placed in a separate bag.

The breakthrough came after police examined CCTV footage from multiple railway stations along the train route. Footage reportedly showed three individuals placing the tin box inside a sleeper coach at Tamkuhi Road Railway Station in Kushinagar before boarding an adjacent AC coach to avoid suspicion.

The accused later got off the train after travelling some distance. Police identified the three suspects as Ansari, his sister and brother-in-law.

Authorities said the accused had travelled around 4 km from their home to the railway station to dispose of the body parts.

Biggan Ansari has been arrested, while further investigation into the case is underway.

#UttarPradesh #Lucknow #CrimeNews #HonourKilling #Shocking #UPPolice

articles.title: CCTV Captures Dramatic Kidnapping of 4-Year-Old in Mohali Amid Custody Battle
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking kidnapping incident in Punjab’s Mohali district triggered panic and outrage after a four-year-old girl was allegedly abducted in broad daylight outside her grandparents’ house in Kurali area.

body.html:
A shocking kidnapping incident in Punjab’s Mohali district triggered panic and outrage after a four-year-old girl was allegedly abducted in broad daylight outside her grandparents’ house in Kurali area.

The dramatic incident, captured on CCTV cameras, was later found to be linked to an ongoing custody dispute between the child’s parents.

According to reports, the girl had just returned home from school on a scooter with her grandparents near Singhpura village when the incident took place.

As the grandmother stepped down to open the gate, two men on a motorcycle allegedly approached and attempted to snatch the child from her grandfather, leading to a struggle on the road.

Moments later, a white sedan reportedly arrived at the spot and several more men stepped out to assist the bikers. Despite the grandparents desperately trying to protect the child, the abductors allegedly overpowered them and forced the girl into the car before fleeing.

The viral CCTV footage reportedly shows the grandparents risking their lives by standing in front of the getaway vehicle and clinging to it in an attempt to stop the kidnappers. The driver allegedly tried to run them over before escaping, leaving both grandparents injured. Reports said they later suffered fractures and were hospitalised.

The child’s father, a government school teacher, immediately accused his estranged wife and her relatives of planning the kidnapping due to an ongoing legal battle over the girl’s custody.

“We have a case ongoing over the child’s custody. Nonetheless, she took the law into her hands and did this,” the father alleged. He also claimed that his mother-in-law and a man identified as Sandeep Kumar were involved.

Following widespread outrage over the viral footage, Mohali Police launched a massive search operation using multiple special teams.

Police later confirmed that the child was safely rescued within six hours of the abduction.

SP (Rural) stated that preliminary investigation indicated the incident stemmed from the custody dispute. The girl’s mother has reportedly been arrested and booked in the case, while police continue searching for her accomplices and the alleged hired abductors.

Authorities are currently examining CCTV footage and questioning all those involved as the investigation continues.

articles.title: “Police Storm Church to Nab Rowdy”: History-Sheeter Arrested Mid-Prayer in KGF Over ‘Hafta’ Threats
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A history-sheeter who had been externed from the district was arrested in dramatic fashion by police in Karnataka’s Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) area after allegedly threatening traders and collecting ‘hafta’.

body.html:
A history-sheeter who had been externed from the district was arrested in dramatic fashion by police in Karnataka’s Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) area after allegedly threatening traders and collecting ‘hafta’.

The accused, identified as Stanley, a known rowdy from KGF in Kolar district, was taken into custody from inside the Susai Palya Church while he was reportedly offering prayers.

According to police, Stanley had recently threatened a pandal shop owner, Mohammed Saqlain, demanding money and allegedly forcing him to provide pandal and decoration arrangements for his daughter’s wedding.

Following the complaint, police launched a search operation for the externed rowdy, who had also reportedly been booked in the Andersonpet police station limits in connection with hafta collection and criminal intimidation.

Acting on specific information, police teams reached the church premises and arrested Stanley in what witnesses described as a “cinematic” operation.

Videos circulating on social media reportedly show police dragging the accused out of the church premises while some women present at the spot attempted to obstruct the arrest.

Police officials said the operation was carried out under the directions of KGF Superintendent of Police.

Further investigation into the extortion and threat allegations is underway.

articles.title: Footwear Inside Temple Leads to Heated Argument at Karnataka’s Badami Cave Temples
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has erupted at Karnataka’s historic Badami Cave Temples after a female staff member was allegedly seen entering the temple premises wearing footwear, triggering a heated argument with a tourist.

body.html:
A major controversy has erupted at Karnataka’s historic Badami Cave Temples after a female staff member was allegedly seen entering the temple premises wearing footwear, triggering a heated argument with a tourist.

A video of the incident, which is now circulating widely on social media, reportedly shows the tourist confronting the staff member inside the heritage site.

The staff member has been identified as Roshani Mustafi, who was allegedly seen arguing with a female tourist after being questioned over wearing slippers inside the temple premises.

According to reports, the tourist objected to the staff member entering the sacred site with footwear and questioned whether staff members were exempt from following basic religious and cultural norms.

In the viral clip, Mustafi was purportedly heard telling the tourist that she had “no right to make a rule.” The tourist then reportedly responded by asking whether she lacked “common sense”.

The tourist also allegedly questioned whether entering a dargah with footwear would be considered acceptable, arguing that similar respect should be shown at temple sites as well.

During the argument, Mustafi was reportedly seen calling her supervisor and saying, “Sir, yaha pe log tamasha kar rahe hai” (Sir, people are creating a scene here).

The Badami Cave Temples, protected by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), are renowned 6th-century cave temples dedicated to Hindu deities and Jain Tirthankaras.

The viral video has sparked mixed reactions online. While some social media users argued that the cave temples are heritage monuments and not fully functional places of worship, others insisted that footwear should still be avoided inside such sacred spaces out of respect.

Some users also pointed out that several tourists visible in the video were themselves wearing shoes, questioning why only the staff member was confronted.

The incident has triggered a wider debate online over cultural sensitivity, temple etiquette and rules at protected heritage monuments.

#Badami #Karnataka #ViralVideo #ASI #BreakingNews

articles.title: Tourists Caught Allegedly Stealing 10 Kg Cheese Bag in Uttarakhand’s Bhimtal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre theft incident from Uttarakhand’s Bhimtal has gone viral after three tourists were allegedly caught on CCTV stealing a 10-kilogram bag of paneer from outside a dairy shop.

body.html:
A bizarre theft incident from Uttarakhand’s Bhimtal has gone viral after three tourists were allegedly caught on CCTV stealing a 10-kilogram bag of paneer from outside a dairy shop.

According to reports, the incident took place on May 18 near a petrol pump on the Bhimtal-Bhowali road, where crates of full and empty milk containers had been stacked outside a dairy shop. A 10-kg bag of paneer had reportedly been kept among the crates.

CCTV footage from the spot allegedly shows three youths roaming around the dairy and surveying the area before one of them quickly picked up the bag and fled when he found an opportunity.

The video has since surfaced on social media and is drawing widespread reactions online.

Local traders expressed outrage over the incident, especially as the tourist season is currently at its peak in Nainital district, with visitors arriving in large numbers to escape the summer heat.

Traders said such incidents damage the image of the tourism sector and create concern among local business owners.

Led by Bhimtal Chamber of Commerce president Pankaj Joshi, traders submitted a written complaint to police along with CCTV footage and demanded immediate identification and arrest of the accused.

Police are expected to examine the surveillance footage as part of the investigation.

articles.title: “Tyre Came Off Midway”: Major Tragedy Averted in Kerala’s Kollam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was narrowly avoided in Kerala’s Kollam district after a speeding bus lost control and overturned near Chittar when its front tyre allegedly detached while the vehicle was in motion.

body.html:
A major tragedy was narrowly avoided in Kerala’s Kollam district after a speeding bus lost control and overturned near Chittar when its front tyre allegedly detached while the vehicle was in motion.

According to reports, the accident occurred while the bus was travelling from Madathara to Anchal. The technical failure reportedly took place as the bus was negotiating a turn near Chittar.

Officials said the driver’s presence of mind helped prevent a much bigger disaster despite the sudden loss of control.

Several passengers sustained minor injuries in the accident and were immediately shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment. Fortunately, no fatalities were reported.

The incident caused panic among passengers and local residents, while visuals from the accident spot have been circulating on social media.

Authorities are expected to conduct a detailed investigation into the mechanical failure that led to the mishap.

#Kerala #Kollam #BusAccident #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “₹10 Lakh or Face Consequences”: Bengaluru Realtor Alleges Threats Inside Office Over Property Dispu
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tense confrontation linked to a property dispute has surfaced in Bengaluru after a real estate businessman accused a woman and two men of threatening him inside his office and demanding ₹10 lakh. The incident was reported under the jurisdiction of Kodigehalli Police Station.

body.html:
A tense confrontation linked to a property dispute has surfaced in Bengaluru after a real estate businessman accused a woman and two men of threatening him inside his office and demanding ₹10 lakh.

The incident was reported under the jurisdiction of Kodigehalli Police Station.

According to the complaint, the accused allegedly entered the office of realtor Venkataraju in Sanjay Nagar and created a scene over a site-related dispute connected to Shivajinagar.

Police said the woman, identified as Sangeetha Ram, allegedly introduced herself as the head of Karnataka Yuva Sene and also claimed to be the president of a women’s organisation. She reportedly arrived at the office along with two men and allegedly threatened the businessman.

As per the complaint, Venkataraju had earlier entered into an agreement related to a site in Shivajinagar, and the dispute allegedly began over the same property matter.

The accused allegedly warned the realtor not to visit or interfere with the property despite the agreement being registered. They are also accused of threatening him with serious consequences if he continued his involvement in the site.

According to the complaint, the businessman was allegedly threatened with murder. The group allegedly warned that they could gather 15 to 20 people and attack him if required.

The accused are further alleged to have demanded ₹10 lakh from Venkataraju, telling him that payment would prevent further trouble.

The businessman also claimed that he was warned against approaching the police and threatened with another assault inside his office if a complaint was filed.

The entire confrontation inside the office was reportedly captured on CCTV cameras installed at the premises. Police are expected to examine the footage as part of the investigation.

A case has been registered at Kodigehalli Police Station, and further inquiry is underway. Police said all allegations related to the property dispute, extortion and criminal intimidation are being verified.

#Bengaluru #Extortion #Kodigehalli #CrimeNews #BreakingNews
